messages:
hema: FYI I opened a docs PR that adds a streaming-resume example + updated 429/timeout guidance. includes small python/node SDK snippets and a tiny repro harness. reviewers welcome :wave:

dom: linking the PR? want to check the snippet style before I review. also where should the repro live — tests/fixtures or examples/diagnostics?

hema: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812 — put the harness under examples/diagnostics/stream-resume. kept it intentionally tiny so it runs in CI (uses mock server).

anya: quick ask — does the doc explicitly call out behavior for mid-stream disconnects (client abort vs server drop)? we should mention what errors clients actually see (499/408/502/504/stream-interrupt).

hema: good call. added a short table in the PR, but TL;DR: streaming abort from client => 499-ish client-cancel in most proxies; server-side OOM or container restart shows up as 502/504; partial chunk then connection close shows up to SDK as stream aborted error.

docs-bot: CI check started for docs PR #812 — link: https://ci.internal.redwood/1234.

mike: For the example, can we show how to resume or retry without duplicating tokens (prefix dedup)? customers keep asking if they should resend last N tokens.

hema: added a small KV-cache-friendly approach: keep last prompt suffix idempotent and use a resumable cursor. example shows using 'last_event_id' header plus a short dedupe window. snippet: ```python
# pseudo
resp = client.stream(prompt)
for ev in resp:
    if ev.id <= seen_id:
        continue
    append(ev.text)
```

anya: also flagged: we need to update error-ref for 429 to include the new guidance about streaming 429s (how to interpret when mid-stream). currently it's only for synchronous 429s.

hema: yep updated error-ref section and added a concise snippet on honoring Retry-After and doing exponential backoff with jitter. I made the code minimal: ```bash
# curl example honoring retry-after
curl -i -X POST 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -d '{"prompt":"..."}' 
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate || echo "retry after: $RETRY_AFTER"
```

dom: CI is green on the example harness. two small nits: 1) move node snippet to examples/snippets/node so the importer picks it up, 2) change `last_event_id` to `stream_cursor` to match telemetry naming.

hema: done both. thanks. also added a migration blurb for SDK users: "If you relied on implicit reconnects, migrate to explicit resume cursors or prefer-at-most-once by checkpointing last-committed token id."

mike: Should we add a one-line note for Dedicated customers about how reserved pools return 429 vs queuing? ops asked for wording to avoid confusion.

hema: added a short note under 'Behavior by deployment' section: Hosted API may return 429s under load; Dedicated opts into queueing which can delay requests instead of immediate 429s — linking to dedicated capacity docs.

anya: tiny editorial: change "Retry-After" casing to quote marks in the text (we def prefer code span for header names).

hema: fixed. ready for final thumbs. :thumbsup:

dom: LGTM, leaving final approval to anya for wording.

anya: LGTM light edits. please merge once CI finishes. :shipit:

docs-bot: PR #812 merged by anya at 1749956865.
